definitions.gloss: unused; brand new; not yet used
definitions.explanation: Describes something that has never been used. Common in product descriptions, listings, and everyday conversation about the condition of items.

examples.japanese: {未使用|みしよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未使用|みしよう}です。
{未使用|みしよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: It was stored in unused condition, so it's very clean.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ (use). Very common in online marketplaces, product listings, and commerce to indicate that an item is brand new and has never been used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未使用|みしよう}{品|ひん}: unused item
- {未使用|みしよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: unused condition
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧{未使用|みしよう}: brand new and unused
- {未使用|みしよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧: unused stamps

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧: brand new (emphasizes being new, not just unused)
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧: secondhand, used (the opposite)
- ⟦{未開封|みかいふう}→未開封：10677_mikaifuu⟧: unopened (still in original packaging)
